Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the historian from the WebSurfer’s results, selecting Al-Ghazali (a Persian theologian/philosopher) as the historian and assigning “Persian” heritage, instead of recognizing that the historian mentioned was Ibn Khaldun, identified in the results as a Tunisian (North African Arab) historian. This was an entity resolution error and a premature conclusion without reconciling multiple candidates.
